name: Sutrix
long_description: Sutrix helps hospital clinical research teams accelerate studies by eliminating manual data preparation. We deploy software into their existing systems, transforming data from EHRs, wearables, and other external sources into validated, study-ready datasets. Our software applies study-specific definitions, reconciles conflicting records, and flags unresolved cases for review, reducing repetitive manual work across research workflows.
one_liner: AI-native statistical analysis for patient outcomes
